results.title: SC stays criminal defamation trial against Rahul Gandhi over remark against PM Modi
results.description: The Supreme Court stayed trial proceedings in the criminal defamation case against Rahul Gandhi over his alleged remarks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi, while issuing notice on his plea challenging the Bombay High Court’s refusal to quash the case.
